entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: A Selesnyan centaur spearmaster on Ravnica, teacher at the Kasarna Training Grounds and godfather of Araithia Shokta.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Araithia's friend introduced to the Selesnya leaders.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Selesnya leader met with Boruvo's help.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle against Bolas and his Eternals.

events.summary: Boruvo leaves the Gruul Clans for the Selesnya Conclave about ten years before the War of the Spark, causing a rift with old friends.
events.quote: transitioned from being a member of the Gruul Clans to joining the Selesnya Conclave

events.summary: Boruvo agrees to help Araithia introduce Kaya Cassir to the Selesnya leaders Emmara Tandris and Trostani, helping form an alliance against Bolas.
events.quote: helping to facilitate a crucial alliance to fight against Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Boruvo fights the Eternals, survives the War of the Spark and joins rebuilding.
events.quote: He later joined in the fighting against the Eternals and survived the War of the Spark

relations.quote: As a Conclave spearmaster, he holds a respected position within Selesnya

relations.note: helped introduce her to Selesnya leaders
relations.quote: He accompanied her and her friends to meet with Emmara Tandris
